study type: Nationwide retrospective register-based matched cohort study
exposure: Women with TBI during pregnancy vs. matched references
TBI during different trimesters of pregnancy
outcome: Need for intensive care unit admission
cohort: 392 women hospitalized for TBI during pregnancy and 722,497 women without TBI during pregnancy
finding: TBI during pregnancy, even a mild one, is associated with an increased rate for CS.
mod_finding: This study found that experiencing a traumatic brain injury during pregnancy was associated with an increased rate of cesarean section, particularly in the third trimester.
